sessions.prompt: Session 1 — petition month (March). Respond to the CFO's email in writing, prepare the March MOR and the pre-/post-petition segregation per CONTRACT.md.
Session 2 — April. Interim compensation order entered; see documents/session2. Prepare the April MOR; address professional fees.
Session 3 — emergence. Plan confirmed; see documents/session3. Prepare the COD/attribute-reduction schedule, the fresh-start determination and the emergence balance sheet.
